transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got the casting call package for the festival's public speaking-role auditions ready for daily sign-off. Before I approve it for publication, I need to hear from our equity liaison and safeguarding coordinator with their operational reports. The current draft accepts self-taped auditions, uses ten-minute prepared sides, and doesn't specify an audition fee or any special minor-participant procedure. Who's ready to report first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report an equity issue. I confirmed with the performers' union office yesterday that the festival's agreement requires a $75 paid audition fee and limits each prepared audition side to exactly five minutes. An addendum to this effect arrived after the current draft call was circulated and has not yet been entered in the casting file. The draft currently specifies ten-minute sides and no audition fee, so it will need to be corrected before publication.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a safeguarding issue. I confirmed with the child-safety officer this morning that applicants under 18 may audition only in guardian-supervised in-person sessions, may not be recorded, and require a dedicated safeguarding procedure in the published call. The officer's walk-through note is still awaiting filing. The current draft accepts self-taped auditions and does not specify any special minor-participant procedure, so it will need to be corrected before publication.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Enter the union addendum specifying the $75 audition fee and five-minute side limit into the casting file.
File the child-safety officer's walk-through note regarding minor-participant safeguarding procedures.

Correct the audition fee to $75, prepared sides to five minutes, and add the dedicated safeguarding procedure for applicants under 18 specifying guardian-supervised in-person sessions with no recording.
Release the corrected casting call package for publication.
